pk: Bavadipika karnanyeva yoga iti tan kurvano yogasTa ityucyata iti sesa labDaniti purvaslokoktaspaswanan labDanityarTa purvaneveti icCa ca tasya yukta ityadina Bagava-tprasadakananaya kartavyatapratipadanadityarTa nanu tyaktvetyasya vyaKyanaBavat kinarTan Basye tadanuvada ityata aha– tata evetiti anyaTa sangatyagadeveti vaktavyatvapraptya gOravapateriti Bava taTa sati ekasya grahane sati etayo sanatvasangatyagayo ko yoga iti jnanopaya ka ityarTa prTageva ta iti sangatyaga sanaBavanan ca yogasTatva-rupavisesanapeksaya prTak svatantran visesanantaraneva, natu yogasvarupavyaKyanarupaniti nanda kalpayisyantityarTa sangatyagasanaBavanayareva vastugatya yogatvad ‘yogasTa sangan tyaktva’, ‘sidDyasidDyo sano Butva’ ityanayo punaruktipariharaya vyaKyanavyaKyeyaBavasrayane sangatyagasanaBavanayoryogatvan sunataya kalpayisyantiti sidDatvananda ityuktan yat sanatvan sa eveti ‘sEtyan hi yat sa prakrtirjalasya’ itivad draswavyan nanu niskananadivisiswa-karnakaranasyEva jnanopayarupayogatvadatra ca sangatyagasanaBavanayorevoktatvenangina karnakarana-syanukte kaTan sa evetyuktanityata aha– yogEkadesa iti 48

s: भावदीपिका कर्मत्यागरूपादिति यज्ञादिकर्मत्यागरूपादित्यर्थः ज्ञानरहिताद् यज्ञादिकर्मत्यागरूपाद् यत्याश्रमात् सिद्धिं न समधिगच्छतीत्यत्र ‘न हि’

pk: Bavadipika anuktatvaditi noksapratibanDakatvenanuktatvadityarTa nasakyavisaya iti ‘karnana baDyate jantu’ iti snrterbanDakatvat karnani tyajyanityasaya tatra sariranatropayuktakarnanan tyaktunasakyatvat tesan ca banDakatvaBavaca tatparityagarTakatvan ‘karnana baDyate’ iti sastrasya na vaktun yuktan asakyavisaye sastra-pravrtyanupapate na hyakase nanTanan sakyaviDananiti Bava tadyatiriktakarnarTa iti ‘karnana baDyate’ iti snarta karnasabda sarirayatropayuktakarnaBinayajnadikarnaparo Bavisyati tesan banDakatve suKena tyaktun sakyatvat ato banDakayajnadikarnakarananuktirBavisya-tityasaya na karnatyaga iti jnapayituniti taTa ca yajnadikarnanan pratibanDakatvena tatyagepi nanovyaparasya pratibanDakasya satvena tadaBavasyapraptatvadityasaya Basye– ityaheti iti sankayan ahetyarTa anigrhitatva iti ‘nanonigrhitan ced banDa’ iti banDapeksaya ‘karnendriyani’ ityadyaslokonvayapara tatra ca niTyacaro banDavaniti vyaKyeyan ‘nano nigrhitan ced banDaBava’ iti banDapeksaya ‘yastu’ iti dvitiyasloko vyatirekapara tatra ca ‘visisyate’ banDaBavavaniti vyaKyeyan noksapeksaya tviti nano nigrhitan cenoksa iti noksapeksaya yastu iti dvitiyasloka anvayapara tatra ca ‘visisyate’ nukto BavatityarTa nana anigrhitan cet noksaBava iti noksapeksaya ‘karnendriyani’ ityadyasloko vyatirekapara tatra ca niTyacarapadan noksaBavaparan draswavyan iti vyatyasa ityarTa eteneti ‘nanonigrhitan ced banDa’ iti banDapeksayanvayaparatvena ‘nanonigrhitan cenoksaBava’ iti noksapeksaya ca vyatirekakaTanaparatvenetyarTa; ‘nanasa snaran’ ityasya nanasa snaranan prati karanatvoktO na tatparyan yena ‘nanasapratyaksaja snrti’ iti vacanena snaranasya nanasatvavyaBicarad ‘nanasa’ ityasya vEyarTyasanka syat na cEvan kintu uktaritya banDanaksapeksayanvayavyatirekakaTanaya nanaso nigrhitatva eveti noktadoesa iti Bava

pk: Bavadipika atretiti varnasranocitakarnana kartavyatva ityarTa ‘neGacakraBinani ca parjanya’ ityutaraBasyanusarena ‘neGa’ ityuktan iti vaksyatiti anupadaneveti sesa taTa ca parityagarupakriyaya parjanyopaBogyatvanayuktaniti Bava ‘parjanyenadyate’ iti parjanyananiti vyutpatinaBipretya vyacaswe– parjanyopaBogyatvaditi nanu parjanyopaBogyatvepi kaTan parjanyakaranatvan? ityata aha– upaBuktena ceti tasya parjanyasya, ‘yadbalad’ ityasyopacayadityarTa parjanyatvan parjanyapadan sa yajna iti parjanyapadapraptihetuButo yajna ityarTa cakranapadyaniti ‘anad Bavanti’ ityadyuktakranena sanpadyanityarTa apadyasyEveti ‘yajnad Bavati’ ityapadyacakrasyEvetyarTa nulan yojayati– apadye ceti sanpadye, ‘cakre’ iti sesa ata iti korTa iti ‘atastvayapi karna kartavyan’ ityatra hetutvenoktasya ‘atasabdasya korTa’ ityarTa cakrapravrtiti tvayapi karna krtan cet tenapi yajnadidvara cakrapravrtirBavisyatiti Bava karnatvaditi cakrapravrtirupaPalan Bavisyatiti budDya karna na kartavyan kin nana? parjanyakrtakarnana tvaya kriyananakarnana karnatvena sanyat tvayapi karna kartavyanityarTa parjanyotpatyasanBave-neti atra hi parjanyasabdena devataBipreta taTEva purvan sankitatvat taTa cedanintanena-snadadikarnana devatotpatyasanBavena ‘yajnad Bavati parjanya’ ityasyayogacakrapravrtirityarTa nanu na cakrapravrti yaTa parjanyakrtayajnena parjanyasya parjanyatvan jatan, evasnatkrta-yajnenapyasnakan parjanyatvan Bavisyati taTa ca ‘yajnad Bavati parjanya’ ityasya sanBavena yukta cakrapravrtiriti cet, tatraha– na hiti karnakarina karnakartara tasya niyataDikari-saDyatvaditi Bava karnatvasananyena karnatvasanyena
ck: pavatipika atretiti varnasranocitakarnana kartavyatva ityarta ‘nekacakrapinani ca parcanya’ ityutarapasyanusarena ‘neka’ ityuktan iti vaksyatiti anupataneveti sesa tata ca parityakarupakriyaya parcanyopapokyatvanayuktaniti pava ‘parcanyenatyate’ iti parcanyananiti vyutpatinapipretya vyacaste– parcanyopapokyatvatiti nanu parcanyopapokyatvepi katan parcanyakaranatvan? ityata aha– upapuktena ceti tasya parcanyasya, ‘yatpalat’ ityasyopacayatityarta parcanyatvan parcanyapatan sa yacna iti parcanyapatapraptihetuputo yacna ityarta cakranapatyaniti ‘anat pavanti’ ityatyuktakranena sanpatyanityarta apatyasyEveti ‘yacnat pavati’ ityapatyacakrasyEvetyarta nulan yocayati– apatye ceti sanpatye, ‘cakre’ iti sesa ata iti korta iti ‘atastvayapi karna kartavyan’ ityatra hetutvenoktasya ‘atasaptasya korta’ ityarta cakrapravrtiti tvayapi karna krtan cet tenapi yacnatitvara cakrapravrtirpavisyatiti pava karnatvatiti cakrapravrtirupapalan pavisyatiti putya karna na kartavyan kin nana? parcanyakrtakarnana tvaya kriyananakarnana karnatvena sanyat tvayapi karna kartavyanityarta parcanyotpatyasanpave-neti atra hi parcanyasaptena tevatapipreta tatEva purvan sankitatvat tata cetanintanena-snatatikarnana tevatotpatyasanpavena ‘yacnat pavati parcanya’ ityasyayokacakrapravrtirityarta nanu na cakrapravrti yata parcanyakrtayacnena parcanyasya parcanyatvan catan, evasnatkrta-yacnenapyasnakan parcanyatvan pavisyati tata ca ‘yacnat pavati parcanya’ ityasya sanpavena yukta cakrapravrtiriti cet, tatraha– na hiti karnakarina karnakartara tasya niyatatikari-satyatvatiti pava karnatvasananyena karnatvasanyena
s: भावदीपिका अत्रेतीति वर्णाश्रमोचितकर्मणः कर्तव्यत्व इत्यर्थः ‘मेघचक्राभिमानी च पर्जन्यः’ इत्युत्तरभाष्यानुसारेण ‘मेघः’ इत्युक्तम् इति वक्ष्यत

pk: Bavadipika asanprajnatasanaDeriti tadvata purusasyetyarTa karanasyEvaBaveneti karnakaranaprasakterevaBavenetyarTa tatprayojanaBavakaTanasyeti ‘nEva tasya krtenarTa’ iti karnakaranaprayojanaBavakaTanasyetyarTa karanasanBavena karnakarana-sanBavenetyarTa tarhiti yadi karnakaranakaranayorlaBahani tarhyasanprajnatasanaDirna kartavya tatra karnalopavasyanBavadityaksepasyetyarTa sanahita asanprajnatasanaDin prapta nanu BeritaqanadavudDoDanayogat kaTanudboDanan ? ityata aha– yogasastreti nanu ‘uktvarTo nasti’ ityatroktirupakriyayan purusasya kartrtvat, ‘nasti’ ityatra tu arTasya kartrtvena sananakartrkatvaBavat kaTan ‘uktva’ iti ktvapratyaya? ‘sananakartrkayo purvakale ktva’ iti snaranadityata aha– udbudDasyeti taTa codboDanarupakriyayoktirupakriyaya sananakartr-katasadBavad yukta ktvapratyaya ityarTa nanu karnadikrtavarTo nastiti kaTan? ‘tasyEva nahatsuKatvat tesan tesanapyupasanadi-Palasya saDitatvad’ (gi.Ba. 2-52) ityadina dvitiyaDyaye jnanikrtasravanaderarcanadi-karnanasca Palasyoktatvadityasankya pariharati– evan tarhiti nanvasanprajnatasanaDyaparityagahetutvanaDikaPalaniseDasyEva karnakaranenaDikaPalasadBave sanaDiparityagasyavasyakatvat na tu sanaPalaniseDasya sanaDikarnano sanaPalakatve purvapraptasanaDiparityagayogat, tatasca kaTan ‘sano va’ iti taniseDa? ityata aha– sanapratiseDa iti yada sanorTo nasti tadaDiko nastiti kin vaktavyan? iti kEnutyarTa ityarTa ata eva vaksyati– ‘aDikyasyEva purvaparityagopayogitvat’ iti nanu ‘sano varTo nasti’ iti kEnutyarTanapi sanapratiseDa kasnat kartavya? sanaPalalaBena purvaparityaga kasnana syat? ityata aha– na tviti sanaPalatve sanaDityagena karnakarane tata sanana-sanaDiPalahanena sanavyavaPalatvaprapte, astviti cena sanavyayaPalan tu karna na hi lokEranusWiyate ‘asatyani durantani sanavyayaPalani ca asakyani ca vastuni naraBeta vicaksana iti vacanaditi Bava saniDanaditi ekasninevarTe satvena sabdasaniDanaditi Bava

ck: pavatipika nanu ‘kunavacanaprahnanatipya karnani ca’ iti sutre ‘catu-rvarnatipya svarte upasankyanan’ iti vartikena caturvarnatipya svarte syanpratyayavitanat ‘caturvarna eva caturvanyan’ iti vaktavyan, ‘caturvarnasanutaya’ iti katan syanpratyaya sanutayarta aniyata ityata aha– vicitra hiti syanpratyayastu tatitapratyaya eveti trastavyan atiriktarteti svartavyatiriktasanutayarupartetyarta tata ca caturvarnasaptat sanutayarte syanpratyaye nitvat ativrtO ‘caturvarnyan’ iti pavatiti trastavyan tesu catursu varnesu ‘racasastu narastatra vipra racasasatvika’ ityatitatparyotahrtapranananurotat tata ca racasastasatvikesveva sutasatvika, kincitracoyuktasatvika, sanaracoyuktasatvika, satvat kincitunatanoyuktasatvika iti varnapeta iti kitatatparye astatasatyayakatacaryavakyan nanasi krtvaha– racasasteti pasye ‘satviko prahnana’ ityatra racatyanisrasutasatviko prahnana ityavakantavyan nirteseti ‘satvikaracasa’ iti pasye satvasya pratanan nirtesatityarta satvanatikaniti ‘satvika svalparacasa’ iti prananatiti pava tata eveti ‘racasatanasa’iti pasye racasa pratanan nirtesatevetyarta taceti tanasotikan racascetyarta sanasatveti ‘sanasatvaracaso vEsya’ iti vacanatiti pava ‘atisvalpasatvatikyena tanasa’ iti pranananusarena ‘tanasa sutra’ iti pasyan vyacaste– racopeksayeti atika-niti kincitatikanityarta nuktiyokyananusyavarnavipakoyanityavakantavyan yatoktan -‘ye tu pakavata varnastesan petoyanirita’ iti upalaksanan cEtat– trEvityanatra visnorye sarvatikye sasansaya anyatikyan na nanyante srisatracasaracasa ityatipranananusarena racasaracasatayopi krahya anyata ‘yasnacaturvarnasyahaneva karta trEvityasca tatantarputa’ ityatyasankatan syatiti nantavyan

pk: Bavadipika asnadvyaKyana iti aBinivesadyaBavenakartrtva-vyaKyana evetyarTa hetuhetunadBava akartrtvakarnalepaBavayorhetusaDyaBava ityarTa tadeva pradarsayati– jivananiti ‘aBinivesadikan’ ityatradipadena jnanatnakakartrtvaBave-nahankarikan kartrtvan grahyan nastiti tatascayanakarta, taTa ca karnalepasunya iti Bava nanu BagavatoBinivesaBavenakartrtvan kuta? kintu kriyaya niTyatvadevakartrtvanastu taTaca niTyaButakartrtvavatvenEva karnalepa saDyatan, ityata aha – niTyatvan tviti sanananiti taTa ca niTyaButakartrtvavatvan jivesvastiti tesanapi karnalepa prasajyata ityarTa astviti cet tatraha– tesanapiti kinasraya iti yadi caturvarnyan tvaya srswan tarhi kartrtvad jivavat tavapi karnalepa prasajyeta, ityevan jivadrswantanasrayikrtyaksepa karya, sa kartun na sakyate jivananapi karnalepaBavaprasaktO drswantaBavaditi Bava nanu paranarTato lepaBavasya jivesvarayo sanyepi isvarasya niTyatvajnanena lepapratitirnasti, jivasya tu niTyatvajnanaBavena lepapratitirBavati ato jivavat karnalepapratiti syadityevan jivadrswantasrayenaksepo yujyata ityasankate– jnaneneti niTyatvajnanaBavaBavaByan lepapratityaBavatatpratitiBavarupo viseso yujyata ityarTa tasyeti etadrsavisesasya prananesvasravanadityarTa lepeti niTyaButakartrtvena ‘na nan karnani linpanti’ iti Bagavata svasya lepanivaranan kriyananan vyarTanityarTa kuta ityata aha– tasyapiti lepaBavasya-pityarTa tvanate lepavat lepaBavasyapi niTyatvenavasyan jnatavyatvaniTyaButalepaBavajnanena ‘karnaBirna sa baDyate’ iti sruyananan PalakaTanan na yujyata ityarTa taTa hi sankarsanan sutran ‘acetanayogyasatyanyanupasyanyaPalatvaviparyayaByan’ iti hetuhetunato akartrtvalepa-Bavayo

ck: pavatipika artaprakasakatvan ceti artaprakasakatvasya cnanalaksana-tvatiti pava tatkinartanucyata iti ‘aprapte sastranartavat’ iti nyayatiti pava tasya avarakacnanasya vinasakatvenapinatasya cnanasyavrtatvatiti pava vinasakantareti cnanavyatiriktetyarta cnanartayo cnanaprayocakayo yanivartakantaran tatsatanasyEvanusteyatvatiti pava cnanasyacnananasakatvaprasitavapi ‘site satyaranpo niyanarta’ ityasenaha– cnananeveti noktatosa iti ‘tasyavinasa eva syat’ ityatinokta ityarta nanu cnanasyEvacnananasakatvankikare virota syat ‘acnanenavrtan cnanan’ iti cnanasyacnanenavrtatvokte ‘cnanena tu’ ityatra tu tasyEva cnanasya tanivartakatvapitanatityasayena sankate– kintviti acnanavrtan, acnananivartakan ca cnanan pinaneva, ato na virota ityasayenotaranaha– svarupacnananiti isvarasya svarupavisayakan civanistan pakavataparoksa-cnananityarta avityayavrtaniti paranacatikanayaya avrtanityarta yatoktan srutikitikatatparye– atanye prakrti tuste nrsu pratisvikan stite svakunacatika tveka paranacatikapara ityatyuktva katan prakrte paranacatakatvan ? pk: Bavadipika kaTitatvaditi ‘prajahati ityadina’ iti sesa sanyasaditritayakaTanantarBavan jnanilaksanakaTanasyopapadayitunaha– yaTetyadina kaTaniti ‘anta’ ityetadvyarTan suKasyantasTatvavyaBicaraditi Bava aranasuKasabdarTantargatayo-riti atra Basye darsanajanyasuKanevaranasabdarTa ‘para’ ityetadarsanavisayapradarsanarTan svarupa-kaTanan etadaBiprayenEva parasyaranasabdarTantargatatvanuktan wikayan, na tu tacCabdarTantargatatvan parasya taTatve ‘para ityetat svarupakaTanan’ iti praguktaviroDapate, ‘darsanasparsasanBasat’ ityaBiDanaviroDaceti jnatavyan antarityetaditi taTa cantasTitan yatparan brahna tadarsanadi-ninitan suKan arana taTantasTita ye kanadyupadravastatksaye vyaktan yatsuKan tadeva suKa-sabdenocyata ityarTo draswavya paropadravayo ‘anta’ ityetad visesananiti kuta ityata uktan– sanarTyaditi akanksapurtirupad yogyatarupaca sanarTyadityarTa

pk: Bavadipika Binalaksanaviti ‘kanadivarjanan sanyasa’, ‘isvararpana-budDya karnanusWanan yoga’ iti BinalaksanavantavityarTa anuKyeti isvararpanabudDya karna-karananatrarupanuKyayogapeksaya ‘sanyasi ca yogi ca’ iti prTaguktopi sanyasa ityarTa nanu tarhyetadrsanuKyayoge kaTanantarBava sanyasasyetyata aha– yogasabdo nuKya iti ‘yogan tan vidDi’ ityatra yogasabda kanadivarjanapurvakesvararpanabudDya karnanusWanarupavisiswarupanuKyarTa eva vivaksita, tatra cantarBavo visesanasya sanyasasya yukta ityarTa ata eveti yata sanyasantarBavaDikaranan yogo nuKya eva vivaksita, ata evantarBavopapadakan ‘na hi’ iti gitavakyagatan ‘yogi’ iti padan kanadivarjanasangrahaya ‘upayavan’ iti sananyata eva vyaKyasyatityarTa visesyarupayogEkadesanatrasya jnanopayatvasanBavaditi Bava Binalaksana-vato kaTanEkyokti ? iti sankaya kinutaranityata aha– antarButatvaditi sanyasasya nuKyogantarButatvadityarTa 2
ck: pavatipika pinalaksanaviti ‘kanativarcanan sanyasa’, ‘isvararpana-putya karnanustanan yoka’ iti pinalaksanavantavityarta anukyeti isvararpanaputya karna-karananatrarupanukyayokapeksaya ‘sanyasi ca yoki ca’ iti prtakuktopi sanyasa ityarta nanu tarhyetatrsanukyayoke katanantarpava sanyasasyetyata aha– yokasapto nukya iti ‘yokan tan viti’ ityatra yokasapta kanativarcanapurvakesvararpanaputya karnanustanarupavisistarupanukyarta eva vivaksita, tatra cantarpavo visesanasya sanyasasya yukta ityarta ata eveti yata sanyasantarpavatikaranan yoko nukya eva vivaksita, ata evantarpavopapatakan ‘na hi’ iti kitavakyakatan ‘yoki’ iti patan kanativarcanasankrahaya ‘upayavan’ iti sananyata eva vyakyasyatityarta visesyarupayokEkatesanatrasya cnanopayatvasanpavatiti pava pinalaksana-vato katanEkyokti ? iti sankaya kinutaranityata aha– antarputatvatiti sanyasasya nukyokantarputatvatityarta 2

pk: Bavadipika uktaprakaratrayena ‘jivacita’ ityuktaprakarena, ‘vEsanyan dadati’ iti Basyenanvaya tasyEva vEsanyasyEva taTa cayan prananarTa gunanusarinin pujan uktaprakaratrayena sanan drswin sarvaButesu yo nara kurute, tasya visnu prasidati na kevalan visnu-prasada Palan, kintu tadatiriktan castityucyate– vEsanyaniti yacCabdasravanat tacCabda-Dyahara taTa ca ya visana puja sa narasancayat narasanuhat pujakasya vEsanyan itarapeksaya vElaksanyan dadati ‘tan yaTa yaTopasate’ ityadisrute nanu ‘gonahisyorvEsanyanasti’ ityukte gavi nahisyapeksayotanatvarupan, nahisyan caDanatvarupan vEsanyan yaTa pratiyate, taTeha ‘vEsanyan dadati’ ityukte kin irarapeksayotanatvan aDanatvarupan veti sankayan tasya vEsanyasya vyaKyanan kriyate ‘narasancayadutanatvan dadati’ iti taTa ya sana drswi sa viduKan duKaBavo jayate yasnat tad viduKajan viduKatvaninitan yatsanyan tadasya draswurdadati, sanyapraptO duKaBavaprasidDeriti nanu ‘suhrdadisu’ iti sanabudDitvavyaKyanan sanabudDitvavyaKyanaprakarana eva, na tu ‘saDupapadinan’ ityata purvaneva, ityata aha– etaditi etat sanabudDitvavyaKyanan ‘suhrdadisu’ ityadina kriyanananityarTa purvatanan tu yogaruQavisayan, idan tu sarvasaDaranan atastatrEva noktanityasaya taTa casnin pakse ‘yukta ityutyate yogi’ iti laksyoktya yogaruQalaksananirupanan sanaptan ‘suhrt’ ityadina tu ‘sanyabudDi sarvesanapeksita’ iti prasangaducyata ityavaDeyan nanvetat kuto na yogaruQavisayan sopi suhrtsu sastroktapujan karotyeveti cet, tatraha– na hiti ata eva Basye ‘suhrdadisu’ iti ‘pujadi’ iti cadipadan prayuktaniti Bava nanu sopyantaresu kanadirupadisu vaDadirupapakaran karotyevetyata uktan– lOkikesviti bahyesvityarTa ‘suhrdadisu’ iti Basyasya suhrdadisu na nyunaDika, yogyatanusarini ya sastroktapujadikrti sapi sanyasabdarTatvena sanata, na kevalan ‘jivacita’ ityadyuktarupe-tyarTa ‘yaTa’ iti prananasya suhrtsu pujadi yaTa kartavyan, pitrsatrusutesu ‘yaTa kartavyan’ iti vartate, yaTa tadanusarena ya karoti sa sanabudDirucyata ityarTa Endragnent
ck: pavatipika uktaprakaratrayena ‘civacita’ ityuktaprakarena, ‘vEsanyan tatati’ iti pasyenanvaya tasyEva vEsanyasyEva tata cayan prananarta kunanusarinin pucan uktaprakaratrayena sanan trstin sarvaputesu yo nara kurute, tasya visnu prasitati na kevalan visnu-prasata palan, kintu tatatiriktan castityucyate– vEsanyaniti yacaptasravanat tacapta-tyahara tata ca ya visana puca sa narasancayat narasanuhat pucakasya vEsanyan itarapeksaya vElaksanyan tatati ‘tan yata yatopasate’ ityatisrute nanu ‘konahisyorvEsanyanasti’ ityukte kavi nahisyapeksayotanatvarupan, nahisyan catanatvarupan vEsanyan yata pratiyate, tateha ‘vEsanyan tatati’ ityukte kin irarapeksayotanatvan atanatvarupan veti sankayan tasya vEsanyasya vyakyanan kriyate ‘narasancayatutanatvan tatati’ iti tata ya sana trsti sa vitukan tukapavo cayate yasnat tat vitukacan vitukatvaninitan yatsanyan tatasya trasturtatati, sanyapraptO tukapavaprasiteriti nanu ‘suhrtatisu’ iti sanaputitvavyakyanan sanaputitvavyakyanaprakarana eva, na tu ‘satupapatinan’ ityata purvaneva, ityata aha– etatiti etat sanaputitvavyakyanan ‘suhrtatisu’ ityatina kriyanananityarta purvatanan tu yokarutavisayan, itan tu sarvasataranan atastatrEva noktanityasaya tata casnin pakse ‘yukta ityutyate yoki’ iti laksyoktya yokarutalaksananirupanan sanaptan ‘suhrt’ ityatina tu ‘sanyaputi sarvesanapeksita’ iti prasankatucyata ityavateyan nanvetat kuto na yokarutavisayan sopi suhrtsu sastroktapucan karotyeveti cet, tatraha– na hiti ata eva pasye ‘suhrtatisu’ iti ‘pucati’ iti catipatan prayuktaniti pava nanu sopyantaresu kanatirupatisu vatatirupapakaran karotyevetyata uktan– lOkikesviti pahyesvityarta ‘suhrtatisu’ iti pasyasya suhrtatisu na nyunatika, yokyatanusarini ya sastroktapucatikrti sapi sanyasaptartatvena sanata, na kevalan ‘civacita’ ityatyuktarupe-tyarta ‘yata’ iti prananasya suhrtsu pucati yata kartavyan, pitrsatrusutesu ‘yata kartavyan’ iti vartate, yata tatanusarena ya karoti sa sanaputirucyata ityarta Entraknent

pk: Bavadipika taTa ceti tvatprapaternayataranopayatve sarvepi tvan prapadya nayan tareyureva nahi tirna tena jnayate tvatpratipaternayataranopayatvan yat ‘naneva’ ityenenoktan tad asadititi Bava duskrtitvanuQatvayorhetuhetunadBavanupapadayati– viparyayasyeti prasidDe-riti ‘duskarnana Bavenoha’ iti vacanaditi Bava nanu niTyajnanitvena hetuna tanoyogya-nisWanaraDanatvasaDananayuktan rjuvyatiriktesu nuktiyogyesu devesu, taTa nanusyotanesu nityasansari-ButanaDyanananusyesu ca vyaBicarat, ityata aha– devananiti rjuvyatiriktananityarTa kevalaniTyajnanitveti prakaransa ivaDisWanansepyayaTarTajnanasvarupatvan kevalaniTya-jnanitvan, tadaBavadityarTa taTaca na niTyajnanitvanatran hetutvena vivaksitan, yena vyaBicara syat kin nana, sarvatnana niTyajnanitvaneva tasya ca devadisvaBavana vyaBicara iti Bava nuQatve duskrtitvatiriktanapahrtajnanatvan ca heturityasayena ‘apahrtajnanatvaca nuQa’ ityuktan Basye tatra tayorhetuhetunadBavanupapadayati– aDisWaneti prasidDeriti loke suktirajatadiBrane darsanaditi Bava nanu ‘tanoyogya asuraBavanasrita naraDanatvat’ ityatra naraDanananapi tanoyogyatvena paksakowiniksiptataya tatrasuraBavasrayanarupasaDyaBavad baDa ityata aha– jivatrEviDyeti ‘triviDa jivasanGastu devananusadanava’ ‘nityanando nityajnano nityabala paranatna, evan sura, nEvanasura, evananevan ca nanusya’ ityadivakyesu devasabdena noksayogyanan, nanusyasabdena nityasansarinan, danavasurasabdena tanoyagyanan grhitatvena, etadvivaksaya naraDanananapi tanoyogyatvenasuresvantarBavasya prasidDatvena asuraBavasrayanarupasaDyasyapi satvana baDa ityasaya nanu ‘tarhi kiniti sarve natyayan’ iti prasnasya kinutarananena jataniti cet, tatra•ha– asuraBaveti taTa ca ‘tanoyogya na nan prapadyante asurasvaBavavatvat’ tadapi kuta naraDanatvat tadapi kuta nuQatvat tadapi kuta duskrtitvat, apahrtajnanatvaca, iti hetuheteunadBavo draswavya
ck: pavatipika tata ceti tvatprapaternayataranopayatve sarvepi tvan prapatya nayan tareyureva nahi tirna tena cnayate tvatpratipaternayataranopayatvan yat ‘naneva’ ityenenoktan tat asatititi pava tuskrtitvanutatvayorhetuhetunatpavanupapatayati– viparyayasyeti prasite-riti ‘tuskarnana pavenoha’ iti vacanatiti pava nanu nityacnanitvena hetuna tanoyokya-nistanaratanatvasatananayuktan rcuvyatiriktesu nuktiyokyesu tevesu, tata nanusyotanesu nityasansari-putanatyanananusyesu ca vyapicarat, ityata aha– tevananiti rcuvyatiriktananityarta kevalanityacnanitveti prakaransa ivatistanansepyayatartacnanasvarupatvan kevalanitya-cnanitvan, tatapavatityarta tataca na nityacnanitvanatran hetutvena vivaksitan, yena vyapicara syat kin nana, sarvatnana nityacnanitvaneva tasya ca tevatisvapavana vyapicara iti pava nutatve tuskrtitvatiriktanapahrtacnanatvan ca heturityasayena ‘apahrtacnanatvaca nuta’ ityuktan pasye tatra tayorhetuhetunatpavanupapatayati– atistaneti prasiteriti loke suktiracatatiprane tarsanatiti pava nanu ‘tanoyokya asurapavanasrita naratanatvat’ ityatra naratanananapi tanoyokyatvena paksakotiniksiptataya tatrasurapavasrayanarupasatyapavat pata ityata aha– civatrEvityeti ‘trivita civasankastu tevananusatanava’ ‘nityananto nityacnano nityapala paranatna, evan sura, nEvanasura, evananevan ca nanusya’ ityativakyesu tevasaptena noksayokyanan, nanusyasaptena nityasansarinan, tanavasurasaptena tanoyakyanan krhitatvena, etatvivaksaya naratanananapi tanoyokyatvenasuresvantarpavasya prasitatvena asurapavasrayanarupasatyasyapi satvana pata ityasaya nanu ‘tarhi kiniti sarve natyayan’ iti prasnasya kinutarananena cataniti cet, tatra•ha– asurapaveti tata ca ‘tanoyokya na nan prapatyante asurasvapavavatvat’ tatapi kuta naratanatvat tatapi kuta nutatvat tatapi kuta tuskrtitvat, apahrtacnanatvaca, iti hetuheteunatpavo trastavya
s: भावदीपिका तथा चेति त्वत्प्रपत्तेर्मायातरणोपायत्वे सर्वेऽपि त्वां प्रपद्य मायां तरेयुरेव नहि तीर्णाः तेन ज्ञायते त्वत्प्रतिपत्तेर्मायातरणोपाय

ck: pavatipika nahanerustaprahnasatanan arapyatastitanan lokanan na punaravrti ityanyatapratitinirasayaha– parata iti ‘prtivyan prahnano nerO cayantan tvantariksakan trtiyan satyaloke ca satanan ‘nanupetya punarcana’ ityatislokenoktatvat, satyalokan praptanan punarcanasatpavasya ‘aprahnapavanat’ ityuktatvat, ‘nanupetya tu kOnteya’ iti pakavantan praptanan punarcanapavakatananayuktan, pk: Bavadipika ‘sTapayitun’ ityasya visesanasya krtyanaha– pratijneti ‘nanupetya punarjana na vidyate’ ityetat pratijnanatrenEvoktan, na tu yuktyadiBi sTapita-nityarTa sananakartrkatvalaBayaha– avasTitananiti idanpurvatvaBaveti cakravat parivrte pranitatvaditi Bava atnana iti svasya Bagavata ityarTa gitanulanGyeti anyaTa gitanusarena vaktavyan ‘praBavantyaharagane’ iti gitayan srswe praguktatvat srswyadi darsayatiti vaktavyan syadityarTa prasidDarTa dasasatarupa virinceti ‘sahasravrtan tadaha svayanBavo nisa ca tanananitan saracCatan’ ‘caturyugasahasrani brahnano dinanucyate ratrisca tavati. ’ ityadivacanaditi Bava uktan sahasrasabdasyanekavacitvan ‘visvan sanastan purnan ca’ ityaBiDanat ‘paripurna’ ityuktan kalata paripurnarupavato nityadehadinatopiti yavat anena rajanisadBavavacanena aharapiti savyaparavasTEvahariti Bava avantara-srswipralayayoriti dEnandinasrswipralayayorityarTa akasadinaniti brahnanqavarana-ButananityarTa napiti brahnanqavaranaButapancanahaButanasanantaran ahantatvanasa, tadanantaran virincadehasya nahatatvasyapi naso BavatyevetyarTa 17,19

tatanapetatvanucyate, uta nivrtatarnatana-petatvan natya ityaha– pravrtasyeti pravrtatarnasya tvesativarcanavirotitvena tatanapetatva-sanpavatiti pava na tvitiya ityaha– nivrtasyeti etatiti tvesativarcanetyarta ‘karnana sutasatvasya vErakyan cayate hrti’ iti vacanena nivrtakarnana eva tvesativarcanasatanatvena rakatvesativarcanasya nivrtatarnasatanatvakyatatanapetatvasanpavatiti pava praktato’ iti sutrenopasarkananevokta, ityata sratatertravyavacinopi prakprayokopapatyartanevopasarkasancna krtetyasaya ata eva vartikakrta ‘upasarkavat’ iti prasitopasark

pk: Bavadipika Odasinyeti anujnanatradaturloke Odasinya-darsanaditi Bava viroDaditi tatra BartrtvadO svatantryapratiteriti Bava kriya-vrtisceti nantrsabdoktakartavyalocanarupakriyaya avrti punararTakanusabdarTa ityarTa trnorTa iti trnastacCilyadO vihitatvat tatradipadena visesaruparTasyapi grahanaditi Bava nanu nirupaka’ ityuktepi, ajnanatradatrtvan atra praptOdasinyananivaryaneva ityata aha– kartavyasyeti anena nanuDatvarTa uktoe Bavati tatasca preraka iti Bava vyaKyanantara iti ‘jivasya suKaduKanan Bogasaktiprada sada parana puruso visnu. ’ iti pranananusarena jivanan Boktrtve Bogasaktipradane paranatna heturiti tatparyagata-vyaKyanantara ityarTa taTa ca tadapi vyaKyanantaranityasaya nanu ya evan veti purusan prakrtin ca’ ityatra purusasabdena jivesvarayo paranarsa iti Basye vyaKyanantare ca sanan tatra vyaKyanantare ca purusasabdena jiva kutra prakrta? ‘purusa suKaduKanan’ ityatra purusapadasyesvaraparatvat taTa ca ‘ya evan veti purusan’ ityatra purusapadena tatparanarso na sanBavati ityata aha– purusa iti evan ca vyaKyanantare ‘ya eva veti purusan’ ityatra purusapadenoBayaparanarso yukta iti Bava nanvatra Basye ‘ya enan veti purusan prakrtin ca’ iti jivesvarO sahEvocyete’ ityucyate tatra purusapadena kaTanuBayo paranarsa, aprakrtatvat iti sankayan ‘purusa suKaduKanan iti jiva ukta’ ityanena jivasya prakrtatvanuktan isvarasya tu kaTan prakrtatvan ityata ‘purusa suKaduKanan’ iti jiva ukta iti Basyanupalaksanaparanityaha– upalaksananetaditi ‘purusasabdena’ iti sesokti – dbivacaneneti ‘ya etO veti purusO prakrtin ca’ iti dvivacanan gitayan syadityarTa tantreneti sakrduktan anekopakarakan tantran, tanyaya-srayenetyarTa 23

pk: Bavadipika utanajaneti taTa ca ‘aBijatosi’ ityasya ‘satkulaprasutosi’ ityarTo draswavya ayan Datu janiDatu dvitiya ‘sanpadan dEvin’ iti dvitiya upasarganan kriyasanbanDaBave sasaDanakriyavacitvanaBipretyaha– aBilaksyeti dEvin sanpadan devatvanaBilaksya udisya jata ityarTa ‘laksa darsanankanayo’ iti laksaDato sakarnakatvat dvitiya yuktetyarTa devatvena praptadevatvena devendravataratvenasyapi devatva-diti Bava janisanbanDa iti ‘aBijata utanajana’ iti janisanbanDa ityarTa laksyasanbanDa iti aDyahrtalaksyapadena sanbanDa ityarTa uktanupapati arjunasya ‘devatvena’ ityuktanupapati ayanaBirupasargo na cet tarhi kiniti prcCati – kin tviti utaranaha– pratyarTa iti naca aBe kaTan karnapravacaniyasanjna? ‘laksanetTanButaKyanaBaga-vipsasu pratiparyanava’ iti sutrena pratyaditrayananeva laksanadyarTacatuswaye karnapravacaniyataya uktatvat, tatra ca aBeranukterityata uktan – pratyarTa iti taTa ca ‘aBi’ ityasya pratyarTakatvat, tasya ca karnapravacaniyataya uktatvaditi Bava nanu laksanadyarTesu kasninarTetra karnapravacaniyasanjnetyata uktan – laksana iti ‘prati’ ityasyarTaButan yalaksanan tadarTeyanaBi karnapravacaniyasanjna ityarTa taTapi kaTan dvitiyo-papatirityata aha– taTa ceti ‘karnapravacaniyayukte dvitiya’ iti sutrenetyarTa ‘vrksanaBi vidyotate vidyut’ ityudaharanan atraBerlaksanarTatvanupapadayan, drswantena prakrtepyupapadayati – yaTetyadina laksanan cihnan jnapakanityarTa dEvi sanpaditi jatasya tava ahinsadirupa dEvi sanpat aBi purvapraptadevatvajnapiketyarTa etadvihayeti ‘sanpadan dEvinaBijatasya’ ityade sananyoktitvena yatkincitpurusavisayakatvasanBavena arjunavisayakatva-Bavat tatra ‘devatvanudisya jata’ ityarToktavapi baDakaBavad arjunavisayatvenavagatan ‘sanpadan dEvinaBijatosi’ iti vakyaneva vyaKyatanityarTa ‘ata eva’ ityuktan visadayati– arjunasyeti taTa catra ‘devatvanudisya’ iti vyaKyanan na sanBavatityasaya etadarTatveti jatasya punso dEvi sanpat aBi laksanan, jatasya punsa asuri sanpat aBi laksananityarTopapaterityarTa 5-7
ck: pavatipika utanacaneti tata ca ‘apicatosi’ ityasya ‘satkulaprasutosi’ ityarto trastavya ayan tatu canitatu tvitiya ‘sanpatan tEvin’ iti tvitiya upasarkanan kriyasanpantapave sasatanakriyavacitvanapipretyaha– apilaksyeti tEvin sanpatan tevatvanapilaksya utisya cata ityarta ‘laksa tarsanankanayo’ iti laksatato sakarnakatvat tvitiya yuktetyarta tevatvena praptatevatvena teventravataratvenasyapi tevatva-titi pava canisanpanta iti ‘apicata utanacana’ iti canisanpanta ityarta laksyasanpanta iti atyahrtalaksyapatena sanpanta ityarta uktanupapati arcunasya ‘tevatvena’ ityuktanupapati ayanapirupasarko na cet tarhi kiniti prcati – kin tviti utaranaha– pratyarta iti naca ape katan karnapravacaniyasancna? ‘laksanetanputakyanapaka-vipsasu pratiparyanava’ iti sutrena pratyatitrayananeva laksanatyartacatustaye karnapravacaniyataya uktatvat, tatra ca aperanukterityata uktan – pratyarta iti tata ca ‘api’ ityasya pratyartakatvat, tasya ca karnapravacaniyataya uktatvatiti pava nanu laksanatyartesu kasninartetra karnapravacaniyasancnetyata uktan – laksana iti ‘prati’ ityasyartaputan yalaksanan tatarteyanapi karnapravacaniyasancna ityarta tatapi katan tvitiyo-papatirityata aha– tata ceti ‘karnapravacaniyayukte tvitiya’ iti sutrenetyarta ‘vrksanapi vityotate vityut’ ityutaharanan atraperlaksanartatvanupapatayan, trstantena prakrtepyupapatayati – yatetyatina laksanan cihnan cnapakanityarta tEvi sanpatiti catasya tava ahinsatirupa tEvi sanpat api purvapraptatevatvacnapiketyarta etatvihayeti ‘sanpatan tEvinapicatasya’ ityate sananyoktitvena yatkincitpurusavisayakatvasanpavena arcunavisayakatva-pavat tatra ‘tevatvanutisya cata’ ityartoktavapi patakapavat arcunavisayatvenavakatan ‘sanpatan tEvinapicatosi’ iti vakyaneva vyakyatanityarta ‘ata eva’ ityuktan visatayati– arcunasyeti tata catra ‘tevatvanutisya’ iti vyakyanan na sanpavatityasaya etatartatveti catasya punso tEvi sanpat api laksanan, catasya punsa asuri sanpat api laksananityartopapaterityarta 5-7

pk: Bavadipika ‘upa sanipe nisidati’ iti vyutpatin hrdi niDayaha– rahasyan naneti nurtan canurtan ceti vaksyananapranananusarena pranasabdarTanaha– nurta-nurtaniti pancanahaButananeva praptipariharayaha– jagadititi abaDyatvarupan satyatva-natroktaniti natva sankate – evan cediti anyaTeti jagato nuKyasatyatva ityarTa ‘asan gavan naDye krsna gO sanpanaksiratana’ ityukte itarasan kincitsanpanaksiratvan laByate, evan ‘satyasya satyan’ ityukte nirDarane sasWibalad isvarasya nuKyasatyatvan, jagatastvanuKyan vyavaharikasatyatvan laByata iti Bava atra ‘sat tyan’ iti ‘satyan’ ityatra vigrahan darsayati – saca tyaceti nurtanurtan cetyarTa jagata iti sasWyantasatyasabdavacyasya nurtanurtajagata ityarTa ‘sadlr visarana.’ ityadiDatunasrityaha– visaranadikaniti atra ‘sat yan’ ityeva vivaksitan, natu purvavat ‘sat tyan’ iti ityasayenaha– saca taditi nanu ‘jagata satyan’ ityadyarTatrayanaDye ‘jagata satyan visnu’ ityatra srutirukta ‘pratisWa isvara’ ityatra kasnana pranananudahrtan ityata aha– pratisWeti ‘sanula sonyena sarva praja sadayatana satpratisWa’ ‘isana sarvavidyananisvara sarvaButanan’ ityadina jagata pratisWa isvarasceti prasidDanevetyarTa aparan pascatkalinan karyan parasnat purvakalinat karanat pratiseDeti ‘asatyan apratisWan’ ityadipratiseDaprakaranadityarTa ata iti prakaranaviroDayetyarTa syadevaniti ‘parasparan sanButan na Bavati’ iti vadatan nindyatva-nityarTa ‘parasparan sanButan na Bavatityahu’ iti svavyaKyanopapadakatvena ‘paraspara’ iti vakyan vyaKyatan aDuna parakrtavyaKyanasaDutvopapadakatvenapi vyaKyeyan, ityaha– paravyaKyaneti ‘aparan parasnat sanButan’ iti paravyaKyanetyarTa tadvacanan parasparasanBavavacanan isvareti ‘aparan parasnat sanButan’ ityeva na tu ‘isvarena sanButan’ itisvaraksepa ityarTa punaruktiti ‘anisvaran’ ityanena tadaBavasyoktatvena punaruktiprasangadityarTa
